# Dune

By Herbert.

Frank recommended it after our conversation about focus. The ending surprised me, I did not see it coming. The audiobook narrator is excellent.

A good book for a long flight. Key takeaway: decide what not to do before deciding what to do. Not as good as the previous book by the same author.

Lent my copy to Kate, ask for it back in Monday meeting. The writing is clear and the examples are memorable. Quotes I marked are in the margin, transcribe them later.

Worth rereading in a year, especially the chapter on planning.
